🎉 Welcome Back

NextGen PMM Is Here

Welcome to the beta of NextGen PMM — the evolution of what we started as "Future of PMM." We're now official, running on SAP infrastructure, and ready to connect our product marketing community in new ways.

If you were with us during the pilot, thank you. Your feedback shaped everything you're about to see. If you're new, welcome — you're joining at the perfect time.

What's New on the Site

📋 Book of Work — A structured framework for PMM deliverables, organized by domain. Know what great looks like for every output.

🧩 PMM Skills Library — Joule Skills mapped to your daily work. Try them in Labs, then install them in Joule Work Desktop.

📚 Learning Paths — Structured curriculum covering AI transformation, competitive intelligence, messaging, content strategy, and more.

👥 Community — Connect with PMMs across SAP. Share wins, ask questions, learn from each other.

Explore the Site →

🤖 Submit an AI Capability

Help Us Build the Future

We're working to define the best AI use cases for product marketing — and turn them into Skills, MCPs, and Agents that make SAP PMMs the most cutting-edge in the industry.

But we can't do it alone. You know your workflows better than anyone. You know where the friction is, where time gets wasted, where AI could transform your day.

💡 Have an idea for an AI capability?

Visit our AI Intake Form to submit it. We review every submission and prioritize based on impact and feasibility. The best ideas become real tools.

Submit Your Use Case →

📚 Learning

Success Maps: Help Us Build the Best Training

We're building Success Maps — structured learning paths that help PMMs and their teams develop the skills that matter most in the AI era. But we need your input to make them great.

What skills does your team need? Where are the gaps? What would help you most?

Explore the current curriculum, try the labs, and let us know what's working and what's missing. Your feedback directly shapes what we build next.

✨ Spotlight

Simone Maienfisch: The Human Soft Skills Map

AI isn't just about tools — it's about the human skills that make those tools powerful. That's why we're excited to spotlight Simone Maienfisch and her incredible work on the Human Soft Skills Map.

Simone, Global VP of SAP Cloud ERP Private and RISE Product Marketing, has mapped out the 24 skills that matter most in an AI-augmented world — across Thinking, Collaborating with AI, and Mindset.

"Humans guide and decide what matters. AI produces content. It's always a plus — not AI or human."
— Simone Maienfisch
